_comment: Hormonaly MCP Server configuration. Copy to hormonaly-mcp-config.json and fill in your values.

_notes.api_url: Base URL of the Hormonaly partner API. Use http://localhost:5000 for local dev.
_notes.helix_api_key: Partner API key, generated in the Partner Portal. Starts with hk_live_ (or hk_test_ for sandbox). This is the only credential the server uses.
